name: The Arcades
title: A covered-market district of arcades, roofs and an undercroft
axes: x east, z north, y up; metres; the camp at the origin on y 0

tiers.7: the Leads (roofs), Weavers' Rise and the Mound

description: Here the camp is at the bottom: the Market Square is the lowest street, ringed by arcades whose roofs, with the market halls around them, form the Leads, a second street of flat roofs and footbridges at +7 that runs right across the district. North, the Galleria carries you under glass to the Rotunda and along its west arm to City Hall's court, a level approach where zombies drop in from the roofs on both sides. East, you turn left under the arcade and thread the Shambles, a 5 m jettied lane with a dog-leg, to the Wool Hall, a ground-level door. South, you jog right under the arcade and a covered ramp sinks into the Undercroft, a vaulted street under Market Row lit by one light well, to the Bonded Vaults in a sunken yard. West, a two-flight stair tower lifts you onto the Leads, and you cross the roofs and their bridges to the Exchange Loft, raised on Weavers' Rise. Sight lines are short everywhere: the danger is above and below you, not down the street.
